prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, flat colour and black outlines everywhere except the faces, which are rendered with startling real skin: pores, stubble, sweat, tired wet eyes. Every flat colour is laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Only the bodies, clothes and places are cartoon: every face in the frame, however small, is painted as real human skin with wrinkles, pores, bags under the eyes and real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, and no feature is exaggerated. High from a rooftop across a 1930s city square at dusk, chimney pots in the near foreground: on the far side, a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain stands on a grand stone balcony, arm flung out. From his hand a long ribbon of blank white envelopes streams out on the wind in one clean arc, over the heads of the packed crowd below, and pours neatly down into a single iron storm drain at the kerb. Every upturned face in the crowd follows it. The small red moon low in the darkening sky. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
